b2_null_inputs.returns_basis: price return entry to exit, funding excluded

cost_convention: 7 bps per side on traded notional x leverage; B0/B1 turnover is netted between consecutive TARGET weights (sum |w_new - w_old|), not drifted holdings; B2 pays 14 bps on gross 1.0; counters (trades, turnover, funding, liquidations) cover scored periods only

D1_funding.note: annualized = sum of settlement rates / days observed in the month * 365; positive = longs pay

diagnostics.note: post-start data only; empty until sessions, settlements and weeks after the start are published
